info.summary: Single-node KVM administration and customer self-service API
info.description: Administrator automation uses /api/v1 with a scoped bearer API key or administrator session. Customer self-service uses /api/public with a VM-scoped status session. Long-running KVM operations return durable jobs.

Both safeguards default to false. A deletion lock rejects VM deletion; snapshot_before_reinstall aborts disk replacement unless its pre-reinstall snapshot succeeds.

post.summary: Verify a local image or securely download and verify an HTTPS source
post.description: When local_path names an existing file, the server hashes it in place. Otherwise source_url and a trusted checksum_sha256 are required: the server permits HTTPS port 443 only, revalidates and pins public DNS destinations across at most five redirects, permits one node-wide remote transfer, preserves at least 512 MiB of image-storage space, streams at most 16 GiB into a temporary file, and atomically publishes only after the digest matches.

post.summary: Upload and checksum an image with a bounded multipart stream
post.description: The file limit is 16 GiB. Uploads share the node-wide one-image-transfer limit and preserve a 512 MiB image-storage reserve; requests without Content-Length reserve the full limit. The server always records its computed SHA-256; when sha256 is supplied, a mismatch rejects the upload. Upload form names differ from catalog JSON names: provisioning_mode maps to install_mode, and sha256 maps to checksum_sha256.

architecture.description: Defaults to the server architecture when omitted.

get.summary: Read persisted settings and environment-owned runtime values
get.description: The response names the only writable sections: general, network, console and security. The nested runtime object is read-only and reflects process environment/configuration values.

patch.summary: Validate and field-merge supported setting sections
patch.description: Only general, network, console and security are accepted. Fields in each supplied object are merged into that stored section. Runtime values and administrator credentials are not writable here.

get.summary: Read signed-updater, executor and rollback state
get.description: This endpoint performs no network fetch or host mutation. It validates bounded root-owned helper statuses, returns them newest first, and exposes at most one current non-secret rollback point. Snapshot paths and activation receipts are never returned. Disabled nodes still return 200 with enabled=false and a reason.

200.description: Updater capability and current in-memory verification/staging state

post.summary: Fetch and authenticate the latest signed release manifest
post.description: Fetches bounded release metadata, manifest, and detached Ed25519 signature from the fixed ItzGlace/vexa-vm source. It downloads no component archive and performs no host mutation.

post.summary: Download and verify one signed Vexa-VM release archive
post.description: Only component=vexa-vm has a stageable archive. qemu and libvirt are OS-package-manager components. The supplied digest must match the current verified manifest; the response never reveals the local staging path.

200.description: Artifact staged or an existing matching artifact reverified

post.summary: Approve exact signed components for privileged activation
post.description: Requires a super_admin browser session; bearer API keys are rejected even with updates:write. The request must accept maintenance impact and match the current verified release and manifest. The web process only queues a 15-minute approval-bound request for the separately installed privileged helper.

202.description: Approval-bound activation request queued for the privileged helper

post.summary: Approve the current application rollback point
post.description: Requires a super_admin browser session; bearer API keys are rejected even with updates:write. The request must accept maintenance impact and match the current server-published activation ID and previous release. Snapshot paths and digests, the manifest digest, component set and active release are derived from validated root-owned helper status and cannot be supplied by the caller. The web process queues a new 15-minute approval-bound request for the privileged helper.

202.description: Approval-bound rollback request queued for the privileged helper; this is not an execution-success result

This route cannot change BCP38, IPs, resource sizes, speed, or traffic allowance and returns 409 during VM maintenance.

adminApiKey.description: A scoped administrator API key. The plaintext value is returned only when the key is created. An optional ip_allowlist is checked against the socket peer, or a forwarded address only when the immediate peer is loopback.

adminSession.name: vexa_session
adminSession.description: Secure HttpOnly administrator browser session. Writes also require X-CSRF-Token.

customerSession.name: vexa_status
customerSession.description: Secure HttpOnly VM-scoped customer session. Writes also require X-CSRF-Token.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Required for state-changing requests authenticated by a browser cookie; ignored for bearer API keys.

PublicCsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
PublicCsrfToken.description: Must match the readable vexa_status_csrf cookie for every customer write.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional opaque retry key. It must contain 8-128 ASCII graphic characters excluding quotes and backslashes.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum rows requested. The handler default is 100 and no explicit maximum is enforced.

MetricLimit.name: limit
MetricLimit.description: Maximum raw samples. Defaults to 1000 for host metrics and 2000 for VM metrics.

Since.name: since
Since.description: Inclusive Unix timestamp in seconds. Overrides range.

Range.name: range
Range.description: Recognized values are 15m, 6h, 24h/1d, and 7d. Omitted or unrecognized values use one hour.

VmId.name: vm_id
VmId.description: VM UUID or case-insensitive VM name.

AddressId.name: address_id
AddressId.description: IP-address record UUID or literal IPv4/IPv6 address.

CompatibilityAddress.name: address
CompatibilityAddress.description: IP-address record UUID or literal IPv4/IPv6 address.

AcceptedOperation.description: A durable administrator job was queued

PublicAcceptedOperation.description: A durable VM-scoped customer job was queued

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked credential

Forbidden.description: Credential lacks the required role/scope or CSRF validation failed

NotFound.description: Resource was not found in the caller's scope

Conflict.description: Resource state, allocation, idempotency key or uniqueness conflict

Unavailable.description: Required libvirt, KVM or host capability is unavailable

InternalError.description: Internal failure with a request ID

Host.description: Detected HostInfo plus computed allocation, overcommit policy and schedulable CPU/memory, listener, network, hypervisor, IP-capacity, and service-health fields. Additive capacity fields preserve existing API compatibility.

traffic_limit_bytes.description: Zero/null is unlimited. Exceeding a positive allowance disables the VM's primary live and persistent network link.

traffic_used_bytes.description: Persisted sampled RX+TX deltas. The first sample after a service restart is only a new baseline.

VmRecord.description: Persistent VM fields are always present. Enrichment properties are permitted here because list/detail/update add them; the raw VM nested in create responses omits them.

VmCreate.description: When iso_id selects a manual installer, password must be omitted or null; no password is generated or stored. Other image modes and a blank disk generate a stored provisioning password when password is omitted, null, or blank after trimming. The selected catalog image is authoritative for os_family. When root_username is omitted, the server defaults it to Administrator for Windows images and root otherwise.

iso_id.description: Omit or null to create a blank disk.

firmware.description: uefi selects UEFI; other values currently provision BIOS and are stored verbatim.

traffic_limit_bytes.description: Zero/null is unlimited; exceeding a positive allowance disables the VM network.

items.description: IP record UUID or literal address.

root_username.description: Optional guest administrator account. Defaults to Administrator for a Windows catalog image and root otherwise. An explicitly supplied valid local account name is preserved.

password.description: For blank, cloud-init, and automatic images, omit, use null, or supply only whitespace to generate a stored provisioning password; any other value must contain at least 8 characters after trimming. Every non-null value is rejected when iso_id selects a manual installer.

install_guest_tools.description: Opt-in. Requires a compatible automated image and an available OS artifact. Windows additionally requires image metadata guest_tools_provisioner=cloudbase-init-nocloud and virtio_serial_driver=installed_signed for a provider-supplied signed driver; Vexa does not bundle the driver.

metadata.description: Opaque JSON metadata; defaults to null when omitted.

disk_gib.description: May increase but never shrink capacity.

network_limit_mbps.description: A positive value queues a resize. null is treated as an omitted field and does not clear the existing limit.

traffic_limit_bytes.description: Zero means unlimited; exceeding a positive value disables the VM network. null is treated as an omitted field and does not clear the existing value.

timezone.description: null is treated as an omitted field and does not clear the existing value.

image_id.description: Image UUID or slug. iso_id is also accepted as a compatibility alias.

password.description: Replacement provisioning password for cloud-init or automatic images. It may be omitted only when the VM already has an encrypted credential. A non-null value is rejected for a manual installer; after that manual reinstall succeeds, any prior stored password is cleared.

install_guest_tools.description: Install Guest Tools, or preserve it when already installed. Only compatible automated images are accepted.

disk_gib.description: Optional replacement disk size for a destructive plan downgrade. It may shrink only as part of reinstall and cannot exceed the current disk; use VM resize for growth.

traffic_used_bytes.description: Persisted sampled RX+TX deltas. A service restart establishes a new baseline and leaves an unaccounted interval.

traffic_limit_bytes.description: Zero/null is unlimited; exceeding a positive allowance disables the VM network.

network_blocked.description: True only when Vexa-VM successfully disabled and owns the VM link state.

guest_tools.description: Non-null for a hostname patch. applied=true means the running guest acknowledged the encrypted v2 command; a saved value alone is not live success.

generated_password.description: The generated credential for a new non-manual VM, null when a password was supplied or a manual installer was selected, and omitted on an idempotent replay.

replayed.description: Present only on an idempotent replay; generated_password is then omitted.

guest_agent_applied.description: Compatibility boolean mirroring guest_tools.applied on VM DNS writes.

dns_servers.description: Ordered provisioning values. An empty array clears the stored list; duplicates are normalized.

password.description: Stored provisioning password; it may differ from a password changed inside the guest.
Encrypted and stored, then applied live when authenticated Vexa Guest Tools is connected.

ssh_keys.description: OpenSSH public keys beginning with ssh-, ecdsa-, or sk-. Omit or send an empty array to clear the stored list.

applies_on_reinstall.description: True when the live action remains pending.

status.description: healthy is returned by an authenticated probe; rejected means the authenticated guest declined the command and pending is false.
ready is reported as offline when the last authenticated health response is older than five minutes.

replayed.description: Present only on an idempotent replay.

scopes.description: An empty or omitted array receives the server's default customer scopes. Recognized canonical values are vm:read, vm:power, vm:reinstall, vm:dns, vm:password:read, vm:password:write, ssh:write, firewall:read, firewall:write, and vm:vnc. Firewall access is not part of the default scope set and must be granted explicitly.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds, numeric text, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Omit/null/empty text for the seven-day default.

reserved.description: Individual addresses, inclusive start-end ranges, or small CIDRs to materialize as reserved.

pool_id.description: The IP pool/range record associated with this explicit address.

blacklisted.description: Present on collection responses; true when an active blacklist CIDR covers the address.

pool_enabled.description: Present on collection responses; false when the address belongs to a disabled or missing pool. Existing ownership remains visible.

assignable.description: Present on collection responses; true only when the address is free, not blacklisted, and unpooled or in an enabled pool.

metadata.description: Opaque JSON metadata; defaults to null when omitted.

address.description: IP-address record UUID or literal address.

name.description: Compatibility alias for vm_id; it may contain a VM name because VM lookup accepts ID or name.

available.description: True only when the enabled catalog entry has a server-recorded successful verification, a SHA-256 digest, and a regular local file that currently exists.

metadata.description: Opaque JSON metadata. verified_at, downloaded_at, source, and download_error are server-reserved integrity keys and are cleared from client writes.

provisioning_mode.description: Compatibility alternative to install_mode; ignored when install_mode is supplied.

source_url.description: HTTPS port-443 image URL. When supplied, checksum_sha256 is required before creation and verify downloads the image.

url.description: Compatibility alias for source_url; checksum_sha256 is required.

local_path.description: Absolute canonical path within the configured ISO storage root.

checksum_sha256.description: Required trusted digest for every remote source_url; optional for local files and uploads.

metadata.description: Opaque JSON metadata; defaults to null when omitted. Windows Guest Tools automation requires guest_tools_provisioner=cloudbase-init-nocloud and virtio_serial_driver=installed_signed, meaning the image provider already installed a trusted signed virtio-serial driver.

source_url.description: Changing this value invalidates any previously downloaded local copy and requires checksum_sha256.

metadata.description: Opaque JSON metadata. Windows Guest Tools automation requires guest_tools_provisioner=cloudbase-init-nocloud and virtio_serial_driver=installed_signed, meaning the image provider already installed a trusted signed virtio-serial driver.

admin_username.description: Present for an administrator browser session; omitted for API-key authentication.

node_name.description: Stored control-plane label; does not rename the Linux host.

locale.description: Stored preference; does not reconfigure the host locale.

timezone.description: Stored preference; does not reconfigure the host clock.

ntp_servers.description: Stored preference; does not reconfigure the host NTP daemon.

memory_overcommit_ratio.description: Admission-accounting ratio only. Every VM boots with and retains its full configured memory entitlement; VirtIO balloon support is retained for metrics and entitlement repair.

default_bridge.description: Default for later VM provisioning; does not create or reconfigure a host bridge.

default_traffic_quota_bytes.description: Default enforced allowance for new VMs. Must be positive unless the main administrator enables unlimited traffic.

allow_unlimited_traffic.description: Main-administrator-controlled node policy. False by default; when false, zero/null VM quotas are replaced by the positive node default.

SettingsPatch.description: Each supplied section is shallow field-merged into its stored object and then validated. Only these four top-level sections are writable. An empty object is accepted as a no-op.

ip_allowlist.description: Canonical IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs. An empty array permits every source address.

permissions.description: Grantable permissions include updates:read and updates:write. Even a bearer key with updates:write cannot approve activation; approval requires a super_admin browser session.

scopes.description: Compatibility alias for permissions; update bearer keys may check/stage but cannot approve activation.

ip_allowlist.description: Optional IPv4/IPv6 source networks. Forwarded addresses are considered only from an immediate loopback proxy peer.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds or supported ISO-8601 text.

token.description: Alias of key; both fields contain the same one-time secret.

actor_type.description: Examples include admin, api_key, customer_token, and system.

details.description: JSON details with secret values redacted before persistence.

result.description: Null or any JSON result value.

error.description: Sanitized failure; secrets and command arguments are redacted.

traffic_limit_bytes.description: Zero/null is unlimited; exceeding a positive allowance disables the VM network.

traffic_used_bytes.description: Persisted sampled RX+TX deltas. The first sample after a service restart is only a new baseline.

allowed_actions.description: The raw scopes on the status token.

target.description: Signed Rust target triple; it must match the node architecture and is never caller supplied.

StagedUpdateComponent.description: The local staged path is deliberately omitted.

UpdateCoordinatorState.description: Coordinator state is in memory and is rebuilt by a new check after a service restart.

release.description: Application release currently associated with this rollback point.

previous_release.description: Application release and matching database restored by rollback.

UpdateRollbackPoint.description: Non-secret rollback offer. The root-only snapshot path and activation receipt are deliberately omitted.

activation_executor_available.description: True only when the bounded root-owned helper readiness marker passes ownership, mode, size, and schema checks.

StageUpdateRequest.description: Only vexa-vm is stageable; qemu and libvirt use system packages at approved activation time.

maintenance_impact_accepted.description: Explicit acceptance is required; omission or false returns validation_error.

expected_activation_id.description: Must equal the current server-published rollback_point.activation_id.

expected_previous_release.description: Must equal the current server-published rollback_point.previous_release.

maintenance_impact_accepted.description: Explicit acceptance is required; omission or false returns validation_error.

ApproveRollbackRequest.description: The server derives the snapshot path/digest, manifest digest, components and active release. Supplying those fields is rejected.

expires_at.description: Approval expires 900 seconds after it is recorded.

release.description: Prior application release requested by the validated rollback point.

expires_at.description: Approval expires 900 seconds after it is recorded.

syn_rate_limit_pps.description: Administrator-owned inert preset until ddos_enabled is explicitly enabled.

udp_rate_limit_pps.description: Administrator-owned inert preset until ddos_enabled is explicitly enabled.

icmp_rate_limit_pps.description: Administrator-owned inert preset until ddos_enabled is explicitly enabled.

new_connection_limit_pps.description: Administrator-owned inert preset until ddos_enabled is explicitly enabled.

concurrent_connection_limit.description: Reserved. A non-null value is rejected in this release.

drop_invalid_packets.description: Administrator-owned packet check. It is off by default and only enforced when DDoS protection is explicitly enabled.

VmNetworkSecurityPatch.description: All enforcement switches default off. Thresholds and rules may be edited while off but remain inert. Enabling ddos_enabled requires at least one configured supported limiter, port-scan protection, or invalid-packet dropping.

concurrent_connection_limit.description: Reserved; only null is accepted in this release.

CustomerVmNetworkSecurityPatch.description: Customer status sessions may only toggle firewall/DDoS enforcement. Thresholds, packet checks, default actions, concurrent-connection settings, and administrator/system rules remain administrator-owned. Both switches default off.

end.description: Must be greater than or equal to start.

enabled.description: Inert until explicitly enabled and the VM firewall is enabled.

CustomerFirewallRuleCreate.description: A customer-owned port block. CIDRs, source ports, egress rules, accepts/rejects and logging are administrator-only.

CustomerFirewallRulePatch.description: Only a customer-owned inbound TCP/UDP destination-port block may be changed.

owner_id.description: Set for customer_token-owned rules; otherwise normally null.

ip_ownership_guard_enabled.description: TAP-scoped ownership enforcement for addresses inside Vexa-managed pools.
Managed-pool ownership guard; defaults to true.

bcp38_enabled.description: Optional full anti-spoofing filter; defaults to false.

created_by.description: The server replaces this with the authenticated actor.

CustomerReinstall.description: Resource, speed and traffic-limit fields are intentionally absent. A manual installer cannot receive a provisioning password and clears the previously stored password only after reinstall succeeds.

password.description: Optional replacement provisioning password for cloud-init or automatic images. A non-null value is rejected for a manual installer.
